cases.requirement: Resume a bounded mission across fresh processes without losing identity
Duplicate start reuses the same mission and events are not duplicated
Changed target invalidates a previously admitted subject
Incomplete construction artifacts cannot be silently reused
Target code is inspected statically and never imported or executed
Generated consumer changes behavior under missing/excluded evidence
Unknown evidence coverage blocks readiness; it cannot become equality
Non-JSON, oversized, failed or missing REA provider blocks honestly
Graph edges trace target, observation, brief, candidate, tests and lesson
Failed missions remain preserved; successor attempts get distinct identities
A deliberately broken consumer must fail the behavioral qualification
Real pinned REA package inspects an owned JavaScript fixture
Source files remain byte-identical; mission state cannot live in target
Runtime code changes invalidate unfinished mission continuation
Two workers do not commit the same transition twice

falsification: A reachable path that permits target/source mutation, stale-subject reuse, false-green qualification, or silent loss of a failed attempt invalidates this bounded denominator and requires a new version.
